name: Motion · Presence examples
author: Motion B.V.
description: 10 reviewed MIT Motion source variants in one collection. Original code, current client imports and dependency notices stay distinct. These are technical examples requiring production accessibility review.
usage: Install React, React DOM and motion in your consuming project. The preview uses motion 14.6.0; original code imports framer-motion.
Copy Example.tsx into a client component and render its App export. Review fixed sizing, keyboard controls and reduced motion before production use.

Original source is unchanged under upstream/. Example.tsx only adds the Next client boundary and current motion/react import. The separate MigBits preview adds pause/reduced-motion handling; that wrapper is not silently claimed to be part of the upstream source.
No Motion+ components, website screenshots, photos or paid examples are included. The source is a technical example, not a complete application.

Adapted Example.tsx also replaces upstream photo URLs with original MigBits SVG geometry. No external photograph is downloaded or redistributed. Original URL references remain text in upstream/Example.tsx; preserve MIGBITS-ADAPTATION-LICENSE for the replacement artwork.
validationScope: Individual Chrome render and source checks; full production and accessibility review remain separate.
